Hello there



Switch the email to plain text: In the Thunderbird menu, go to View > Message Body As and select Plain Text. Thunderbird will instantly disable all HTML tricks and invisible layers used by the spammer. You can then select and copy the email address as usual.


Use the message header: Click the Details button at the very top of the email (next to the 'From' field). Often, you will be able to right-click and copy the email address normally from there

content: My guess is you accidentally set up PC account as POP. The phone and PC must both be using IMAP to see from either device. Or, it may be that the PC is IMAP and the phone is POP.
